summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file defining two services: a Joomla web application and its associated database. The highlighted lines mark the two main services that will run together as part of this containerized application stack.

explanations.2: The double-slash comments with 'highlight-next-line' are special markers used by documentation tools to draw attention to the following line in rendered output.
explanations.3: This defines the first service called 'joomla', which will be the web server running the Joomla content management system.
explanations.6: This defines the second service called 'joomladb', which is the database service that stores all the Joomla application data.
